tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /yang lan mkhas pa'i mig thur spyan dbye'i cho ga bzhugs// drang dang ji bzhin don min ldem po'i ngag /'doms mdzad bshes gnyen gzhan las ches lhag pa/ /nges gsang bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis pad dkar snying / /tshims mdzad 'dren pa rnam gsum 'dir phyag yin/ /brtsad cing dris pa ngag gi dbyug pa yis/ /bsnun yang ldab ldib dbyar dus rnga zlum sgras/ /snyan pa bsrings tshe ma brdungs lha yi rnga/ /stong gsum khyab pa'i sgra la sus mi nyan/ /e ma sa lo'i gsung dbyangs sa'i zla ba/ /lung rigs rtog sbyor bsreg bcad ci bdar yang / /nyams min ngo mtshar ched du gsal ba khyod/ /snying nas dran no 'dir byon dge legs mdzod/ /rab dbyer brgal ba'i rnga la brgal lan gyi/ /dbyug pa 'phangs tshe ma 'bral ca co'i 'khun/ /chan bu'i pho nya 'khor zhing 'dir son pa/ /yang lan zas skom 'di sbyin tshim par byos/ /zhes brjod nas/ skabs kyi gleng bslang ba ni/ phyag chen gan mdzod las/ ye shes grub pa'i lung drangs nas byin rlabs tsam gyis smin byed dbang gi go chod tshul gnang 'dug pa la/ ye shes grub pa'i lung la zhib tu dpyad pas/ de skabs dbang gi ming can de/ las dang po ba ma smin pa zhig la bskur chog pa ma yin par/ sngar dbang gis smin ye shes skyes zin pa zhig la rtogs pa bogs dbyung gi ched du/ dbang gong ma dngos sam de byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskyar nas bskur ba zhig yin tshul/ kho rang gi dbang gi gsol btab tu yang / thugs rje'i bdag nyid drin can gyis/ /yang dag ye shes mchog thob ste/ /zhes sogs las kyang / slob ma de la dbang gi ye shes skyes zin par bshad 'dug pa dang / yang dag ye shes kun ldan na/ /bris pa'i dkyil 'khor sogs gzhan du/ /dbang bskur ba ni len zhe na/ /'di ni dam tshig nyams par 'gyur/ /zhes kho la bris sgrub sogs kyi dbang mi dgos pa'i shes byed du/ snga nas yang dag pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa bkod 'dug pa dang /

de'i le'u bco lnga par yang / rdo rje thig rnams gdab pa dang / /tshon rtsi dag kyang bgye ba ni/ /sngags kyi sems dpas mi bya ste/ /byas na dngos grub rnyed par dka'/ /zhes bya ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi thig gdab pa dang / tshon rtsi bgye ba la sogs pa mi bya'o/ /sngags kyi sems dpa' zhes bya ba ni/ yid skyob pa'i phyir sngags ni ye shes yin te yang dag pa'i ye shes mthong ba zhes bya ba'i don to/ /gal te rmongs pas de ltar byed na ni byang chub rnyed par dka' bar 'gyur te/ byis pa'i skye bo las dang po pa'i sems can gyi bya ba byed pas/ sangs rgyas nyid dang rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid rnyed par dka' bar 'gyur zhes bya ba'i don to/ /zhes sogs tshig las 'dir slob ma sngags kyi sems dpa' de ni las dang po ba ma yin par dbang gi ye shes skyes zin drod 'bring po tsam ma mtha' thob pa zhig yin par tshig so so'i nus pa las thon pas/ dbang de byis pa ma smin pa la ci tol du bskur chog pa zhig min par 'dug go zhes sogs zhus pa'i lan chan bur btab pa ni/ tshig 'di byin rlabs las cho ga rno bar mthong nas gsol ba btab pa zhes dang / de'i 'phros las/ shog byang khron pa 'di'i gting yang / /dpog pa'i rnam dpyod mi ldan par/ /chos tshul rgya mtsho'i klong gzhal ba'i/ /re ba byed pa e ma mtshar/ /rnam dpyod 'bring zhig gis shog byang de lan gsum dal bur bklags pa nyid kyis gzhung der ji ltar bstan pa rig par 'gyur la/ de ltar mi go na ni/ bshad kyang mi go bas btang snyoms ngal gsor chug cig ces bris snang ba ni/ rang gi bdag nyid rig pa'i bka' stsal ba de ga bdag nyid kyang sems byin rlabs las cho ga rno zhes pa ni rang gsung dang 'gal te/ sngar byin rlabs yin gsungs/ phyis de las logs par bka' bstsal pa'i phyir ro/ /ye shes grub pa'i tshig gi nus pa la dpyad pa'i rnam dpyod kyi bka' bstsal ci yang mi snang bar/

shog byang khron pa 'di'i gting yang / /zhes sogs kyi gsung mtho yang / rta thul gyis dris mes po'i lan/ /min na padma dkar po'i spyan/ /gyen du mi bsgril 'dzum pa'i zhal/ /tshems dkar 'od kyis tshim par mdzod/ /sngags kyi sems dpa' gsal byed rdo rje'i tshig /mdud pa bkrol yang srin bu'i kha chu bzhin/ /dam du bcings sam gsung mgrin bu ga nas/ /ca co 'khyog por sgrogs 'di gzhan du ci/ /yang mchan bu'i 'phros las/ rgyud sde zab mo la sbyangs ma sbyangs gtam mgo mthong gis chod par snang ste/ sngags kyi sems dpa' zhes pa mthong lam skyes zin la snyeg rgyu yin na ni/ byas na dngos grub rnyed par dka' zhes de ma thag tu 'byung ba'i dngos grub de/ sgom lam mi slob lam las 'os med/ theg chen 'phags pa shin tu sbugs 'thums so/ /lam de gnyis po mnyam na/ rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid rnyed dka' bar 'gyur zhes gsungs pa yang sangs rgyas las logs su bkar don med do/ /zhes bris snang ba ni/ rgyud sde zab mo la sbyangs ma sbyangs gtam mgo mthong gis go gsung ba de ka ste/ rgyud ma sbyangs dmu long rig pa 'char/ /bka' mdo rgyud bstan bcos lam rgyus gsal/ /sbyangs mig ldan bde mo'i thang la dred/ /don rbab la lhung ngo su yis zin/ /sngags kyi sems dpa' mthong lam skyes zin pa la snyeg pa rtsa gzhung na med cing kho bos kyang smras pa med pas/ rnam dpyod gron du song / ci ste zer mkhan zhig yod na'ang / byas na dngos grub rnyed par dka' dang ci 'gal te/ bris sgrub sogs las dang po ba'i bya ba byas na de rnyed par dka' zhes pa'i don du snang ba'i phyir/ theg chen 'phags pa sbugs ma 'thums/ theg chen rnal 'byor pa gnyis snang mnyam bzhag la thugs zhugs pas lan pa tsam mo/ /ci ste yang dag pa'i ye shes dang ldan na zhes pas de ston snyam du dgongs na/ rang gi sgrub byed kyi lung rang gi sun phyungs shig

rdo rje 'dzin pa logs su bkar don gsungs pa de yang / rtsa ba sun 'byin du snang bas der dris shig /rtog bskyed bogs dbyung ye shes grub pa'i dbang / /ma smin byis pa'i lto bar ma zhu'i dug /rnam dpyod spyan mi gsal lam thugs bskyed mnyel/ /smre sngags 'o dod bsgreng ba ma gsan nam/ /tshig don 'o ma'i rgya mtsho bsrubs pa'i bcud/ /legs bshad bdud rtsi'i bum bzang rab phye yang / /sngon rabs lha rgan rdul rtsegs bang rim la/ /spyan ras zur mig skyog pos ma gzigs grang / /yang snying 'grel las/ zab cing rgya che'i chos rnams la/ /zhes sogs mchan bur lung 'di zab mo la skal ba med pa la de dag bstan dgos par bshad pa'i lung du snang gi spangs chog lung ci yin gsungs pa yang thugs 'dzol ba 'dra ste/ kho bos kyang skal med las dang po pa la phyag rgya dkyil 'khor sogs spangs chog pa'i lung yin zhes ci la zhu/ zab rgyas chos la skal ldan slob ma mchog rdzogs rim ye shes skyes pa zhig gis phyag rgya dkyil 'khor sogs la ched gnyer mi dgos pas de dag spangs chog pa'i lung yin yang / de ma go bar las dang blo nyams pas kyang spangs chog pa'i lung du 'khrul ba mang du snang bas/ de ni mi rigs zhes snying 'grel gyi lung dang sbyar te rnam par phye ba lags/ snying 'grel tshig don ma phyed gsar bus kyang / /bris sgrub dbang sogs gcod la snying rje nas/ /phyi ma'i yon tan skyes tshe snga ma rnams/ /spangs chog lung zhes drang po kha nas shor/ /yang dbang dang bskyed rim la ma brten par rdzogs rim rkyang pas grol bar 'dod pa/ bla med lam gyi gnad bcos zhes pa'i lan mchan bur/ bla mas tshig gcig ma bstan ces sogs smra ba don med du song zhes gsungs pa ni/ don la ma dpyad par tshig la 'khris pa tsam ste/ kho bo cag las 'phro can ngang gis khams 'du ba'am/ byin rlabs can mos gus kyis khams 'du ba zhes pa/

sngar dbang gis smin zin pas 'phros sad pa/ dbang po rab lam zab bla ma'i lam zhes pa'i skabs su de skad gsung ba zhig yin yang / lam zab mo bla ma'i che brjod dang / gsang sngags zab mo'i che brjod byas/ chos ston nyan gyi 'bad rtsol cher ma dgos pa la/ dman pa la dgag sgra sbyar ba zhes mkhas pa la grags pa der snang / de ltar min na chos gang 'chad la che brjod de 'dra re snang bas sgra ji bzhin du zhe na/ rong ston lha dga' dang rje mi la'i dpe'o/ /dbang lam zab khrid ston tshe nyan po la/ /yid ches dad pa bskul phyir bsngags brjod gtam/ /'ar 'ur kun gyis sgrogs kyang ji bzhin dkon/ /ye shes skye ba'i sna 'dren phan dgongs ldan/ /tshig che brjod don du 'khrul ba'i gtam/ /chos dkar po chig thub skyong skyong nas/ /lam lhag ma ris su 'bor dgos tshe/ /rgyu ma tshang 'bras bu re yang dkon/ /lung ye grub gsang grub thabs shes grub/ /mdzod de na bzhugs pa'i dbang bskur gsum/ /rgyud chen por sbas pa bzhi pa'i dbang / /'dis gsang ba sgrogs na mkhas grub 'tshang / /rgyud rgya mtshor skyes pa'i las 'phro can/ /yid dpyod ldan gdengs can mig gis mthong / /gzhan sa steng sa bla 'byung po'i mig /rno bdar yang chu nang bya byed bral/ /yang / chos drug bor nas lam 'bras dang / /phyag rgya chen po la sogs pa/ /gzhan gyi gdams ngag sgom bzhin du/ /zhes par gan mdzod las/ phyag rgya chen po gzhan gyi gdams ngag yin pa dang lam 'bras sgom bzhin pa gnyis ka ma grub pas/ dgag pa 'di ni phyogs chos ma grub pa'i gtan tshigs su song / des na rgol ba nyid tshar bcad kyi gnas su lhung ngo zhes gsungs 'dug pa la/ kho bo'i rtsod spong du/ 'o na/ snga rgol lam phyi rgol la tshar bcad 'byung ba ga la yin zhes zhib tu dpyad pa'i lan mchan bur/ shes pa can la dri ci dgos gsung ba bris snang ba ni/ 'di ga ma dgongs par rnam dpyod phyang mo yug gi skyon te/

rgol dang phyi rgol dpang po gsum/ /nges par byas nas rtsod la 'jug /ces pa ltar/ tshar bcad rjes 'dzin 'byung ba'i rtsod pa byed pa la'ang / rgol dang phyi rgol dpang po gsum rgol ba'i dkyil 'khor gcig tu bsham nas/ de gsum so sor nges pa zhig cis kyang dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /ci ste de nges mod/ snga rgol ni sa lo/ phyi rgol ni padma dkar po'o snyam na/ de ga rtog ge'i klong yangs su ma zhugs pa'i 'ol spyod de/ snga rgol 'das nas ring du lon/ /phyi rgol deng tshe shul du lus/ /shan 'byed dpang po ri rwa phug /tshar bcad nam mkha'i padma yal/ /de dag ci'i phyir snyam na/ phyi rgol gyis snga rgol tshar bcad pa la/ snga rgol gyis sgrub byed ltar snang bkod pa tsam dang / phyi rgol gyis sgrub byed de skyon can yin no zhes brjod pa tsam gyis tshar gcod ga la nus/ snga rgol gyi dam bca' 'am sgrub byed de la 'gal 'du sgrigs pa'i sun 'byin zhes pa/ rtog ge la grags pa'i sun 'byin rnam dag 'phangs pas/ snga rgol gyi log rtog sel ba'i nus ldan du byas te/ snga rgol gyi spobs pa gzhom nus pa gcig dgos pa lags/ snga rgol med sar lkog lab rigs pa ci bzang yang tshar bcad rjes 'dzin rtog ge'i gzhung la ma grags mchis so/ /shar mngon dga'i snga rgol sa paṇa la/ /yul bho ṭa'i phyi rgol padma dkar/ /sku rdzu 'phrul bkod pas 'bel gtam na/ /gzhan yid ches dka' yang bdag blo dad/ /yang kho bo'i rtsod lan du/ snga rgol sa skya pas phyi rgol phyag chen pa sgrub byed ltar snang bkod du chug na yang / phyi rgol khyed la rtags de'i phyogs chos ma grub pa zhes pa tsam las/ sun 'byin rnam dag padma'i 'dab rtser bsgreng ba'i chu thigs tsam yang ma byung ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes bkod pa las/ lan mchan bur/ sngar rgol gyis phyogs chos ma grub pa bkod pa la/ des phyogs chos ma grub par ston pa las lhag pa'i de la sun 'byin ci zhig

sde bdun mdzad pas bstan pa yod na ston rigs so zhes dang / sgrub byed ma grub bo byas pa la smra ba'i lce chad pas pham par song / sgrub byed ma grub pa dang / ma nges pa la ma nges so zhes brjod pa las lhag pa chos kyi grags pas ma gsungs/ zhes bris snang ba'i lan yang / dpyod ldan gzur gnas la snga ma des 'thus/ 'on kyang phyogs chos ma grub pa bkod pa la phyogs chos ma grub par ston pa de sun 'byin yin gsungs pa ni sun 'byin ci la zer rnam dpyod ma zhugs pa ste/ 'dir skye bo phal pa'i ngag 'khyal tsam sun 'byin ma yin pa'i rtog ge la grags pa'i sun 'byin zhig yod pa de 'phangs pas rgol ba'i log rtog bzlog nus su byed pa zhig dgos so/ /de lta bu ston byed/ sde bdun gyi lung yod na ston rigs gsungs pa ni/ spyan zur g.yo na sngar rtsod lan du phul ba'i rtsod rigs las/ rgol bas sgrub par byed pa skyon can brjod na'ang / phyi rgol bas skyon ma bstan na pham pa'i rnam par gzhag pa rigs pa ma yin te/ de dag nyid kyis phan tshun nus pa nye bar 'joms pa la ltos na rgyal ba dang / pham pa rnam par 'joms pa'i phyir ro zhes dang / phyi rgol bas de'i dngos po go bar byas na 'gyur gyi/ gzhan du na gnyis po gcig rkyang rgyal ba dang / pham par mi 'gyur zhes dang / sa los/ skyon can yin yang sgrub pa dang / sun 'byin ma shes pa'i phyir ro zhes gong ma gnyis gsal bar byas pa de yin no/ /de'i phyir 'dir skabs kyi de'i dngos po go bar byed tshul dang / skyon brjod dam sun 'byin de ni/ snga rgol la rtags de ma grub bo/ /khyab pa ma nges so zhes brjod pa tsam gyis ga la chog ste/ de tsam gyis snga rgol gyi log rtog bzlog mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /dper na snga rgol gyis phyi rgol tshar gcod pa la yang / snga rgol gyis don skyon dang bral ba tsam gyi sgrub byed bkod nas/

kho bo'i sgrub byed de skyon med yin no zhes brjod pa tsam gyi ga la chog ste/ sgrub byed de la rtags kyi tsher ma dbyung / phyi rgol gyi tshul gsum shes/ bsgrub bya la shes 'dod the tshom dang ldan pa'i tshe/ sgrub byed kyi ngag bkod nas bsgrub bya nges pa'i rjes dpag skyed pa'i nus ldan du byed pa zhig byung na/ rgol bas phyi rgol tshar bcad de rgyal pham mtshan nyid pa 'byung ba rtog ge'i lugs so/ /sgrub byed ma grub bo byas pa la smra ba'i lce chad pas pham par song gsungs pa ni/ rtsod zla snga rgol khong shar phyogs mngon dga' na bzhugs pas/ rdzu 'phrul bkod pas byon na ma gtogs khyed rnam pas mi dgongs pa 'dra/ rang gi rtags ma grub par dgongs kyang / sa lo'i rjes 'brang rnams ni/ rtags ma grub ces pa'i log phyogs sgrub pa la rnam dpyod kyi lce ring du skyong ba zhig mchis na/ paṇa chen khong gi ljags 'gum pa ci zhig he he/ chos rtog ger grags pa'i rgyal pham la/ /sems log rtog log gam rjes dpag skye/ /rang chig lab lung rigs ltar snang la/ /don tshar bcad rjes 'dzin gad mo'i gnas/ /yang / nā ro chos drug ces bya'i khrid/ /mi la yan chad de las med/ /ces par kho bo'i rtsod spong du/ /'di pa'i rjes 'brang 'ga' zhig rje mi la la zab don chos drug dang / rdzogs rim chos drug gnyis las/ zab don chos drug de mi la yan chad las de ma chad la ma byung ba la dgongs zer ba'i lan mchan bur/ 'di 'dra bka' brgyud gong ma'i gsung min bab col lo gsung ba bris snang ba ni/ kho bos kyang bshad yams su bkod pa tsam ma gtogs/ yid ches kyi gnas su bkod pa ni min/ ji ltar yang mchan bu mkhan po thugs rgyus che dgongs par ni snang mod/ ci 'dra ga yod dam/ rang lan rtsod spong du/ sdom gsum rang mchan ltar/ mi la yan la bsre slad med pa'i chos drug gtsang ma kho na las/

gzhan dang bsres pa'i chos drug de 'dra med/ phyin chad chos drug bsre slad byas pa ma dag snang ba de la dgongs zhes pa'i lan mchan bur/ mai tri pa'i phyag chen ci 'dra gsungs pa dang / lhad gang bcug ston dang zhes 'dri'o/ /zhes bris snang ba ni/ thugs mad na'ang / rang mchan las zhi byed dang rdzogs chen dang lam 'bras la sogs pa cal col mang po bsres gsungs pa de shes byed tshad mar byas pa ste/ chos kyi spyan ldan de la rdzun dang hab 'gros mi mnga' ba'i phyir/ de skad gsungs pa bzhin bka' brgyud chos la goms 'dris byas pa'i rjes 'brang 'ga' yang bsre slad byas pa mang dag yod gsungs pas/ de lugs kyi yig rigs snga phyi la rnam dpyod spyan ras phyogs re min pa'i rnam par dbye ba phyed pa yang gces so/ /pha chos kyi spyan ras zur mig gis/ /rang gzhan gyi chos nor skyon yon rig /bu tho cor shor na skyon yon dang / /chos bden rdzun rtog dpyod ga na 'char/ /yang cal col mang po bsres nas zhes pa la/ lam 'bras sogs kyang cal col du btang gsungs pa ni/ phyag chen rtog ges bslad pa'i tshig skyon te/ rang gi chos rkang tshugs yod bzhin du gzhan gyi chos bsre bar mi 'os pa la cal col zhes par snang ba'i phyir ro/ /yang jo bo nā ro ta pa ni/ dbang bskur dus su mthong lam skye/ /de ni skad cig de la 'gag /ces par/ bka' brgyud gong ma 'ga'i gsung 'gros las/ de ltar na nā ro'i dgongs pa yin zer ba yod ces pa'i lan mchan bur/ su yis zer gsungs pa ni/ rang gi yig cha snga phyi la gzigs pa ma rtsal ba'i lan no/ /yang rab dbyer/ nged kyi phyag rgya chen po ni/ /dbang las byung ba'i ye shes dang / /zhes sogs gsungs pa la/ gan mdzod las/ dbang dus ye shes dang rdzogs rim las byung ba'i ye shes la/ dpe'i ye shes yin pas khyab pa ni rab dbye bas khas blangs gsung ba'i shes byed du/ jo bo nā ro ta pa ni/

/zhes sogs kyis dang po dang / 'phags pa lha'i spyod bsdus su/ /zhes sogs kyis gnyis pa khas blangs gsung ba'i phyogs snga bkod nas/ 'gog byed mang du snang ba la/ kho bo'i rtsod spong du/ phyogs snga rgya mtsho'i gting dpog par ma nus so zhes smras pa'i lan mchan bur/ mthong lam mtshan nyid pa 'phags pa min pa la med pa sgrub mi dgos pas mthun/ dbang bskur dus su mthong lam mtshan nyid pa skye ba dang / skyes pa de dpe'i ye shes su ma bstan na bdag dang rtsod ci dgos zhes bris snang ba ni/ rtsod mi dgos bzhin du phyogs snga ma longs par brtsad par des lan/ 'ben ma mthong 'phong rtsed de min yang / /mda' ma phog gzu bor gnas pa'i gtam/ /shing u dum wa rar me tog 'khrungs/ /don 'di la ngo mtshar su yang che/ /des na dbang dus su mthong lam skyes pa ci yang yod cing / skyes pa de dpe'i ye shes yin zhes blun tshig ci la smra/ 'on kyang jo bo nā ro ta pa ni/ dbang bskur dus su mthong lam skye/ /zhes pa'i mthong lam gyi ming can de/ mthong lam mtshan nyid pa min pa dang / dpe'i ye shes la mthong lam gyi ming btags pa yin zhes pa ni/ sgra zin tsam la ma zhen par nā ro ta pa'i dgongs pa'i mthil blangs pa yin pas/ 'di la som nyir gyur pa dag ni nā ro ta pa'i sngon rabs ma dran pa kho na'o/ /'phags pa lha'i spyod bsdus su/ /bden pa mthong yang zhes pa de yang / rim lnga rdzogs rim skabs kyi dpe'i ye shes la mthong lam gyi ming btags pa yin gyi/ bden mthong mtshan nyid pa min no zhes sgrub dgos te/ de bden mthong mtshan nyid pa yin na/ so skye la mthong lam rang 'khrungs su song bas/ 'phags pa min pa la mthong lam mtshan nyid pa mi 'byung zhes sgrub dgos pa'i gnad de yin/ de tsam ma gtogs dbang dus dang rdzogs rim skabs kyi ye shes mtha' dag dpe'i ye shes su bsgrub pa ga la yin/ yang gan mdzod las/

de ni nyes pa chen po ste/ mtshon bya don gyi lam phyag rgya chen po dang / 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub gtan med du thal bas so/ /zhes gsungs pa la/ kho bo'i rtsod spong du/ de ltar bshad pas rtags ci yang med pa'i bsal ba rkyang pa zhig nam mkhar 'phyang ba ste/ rigs pa mkhyen par e 'gro na/ zhes pa'i lan mchan bur/ 'di lta bu'i rtog ge ba rtags khas blangs bkod pa zhes bris snang ba ni thugs mad/ rtogs ldan la rigs pa mkhyen pa zhes bos pas lan/ khas blangs rtags su bkod pa la rgol bas khas blangs ngos shes pa zhig dgos pa lags/ de min par kho bo'i rtsod spong du/ gal te dbang dus dang / rdzogs rim skabs su mtshon bya don gyi ye shes mi skye bar khas blangs pa'i phyir gsung rgyu yin na ni/ gong du ngo sprad zin pas rkun po'i mtshang brtol ba bzhin no zhes bris pa gzigs bzhin du/ slar yang rtags khas blangs rtags bkod gsungs pa ni rigs pa'i grwar phyag ma phebs pa mtshon byed do/ /gzhan khas blangs rtags su bkod byas nas/ /don mi 'dod thal bar 'phangs pa'i tshe/ /khong rgol ba lan gyi lce chad na/ /chos rtog ge'i sun 'byin de la zer/ /khong rgol bas rtags la lan thebs tshe/ /rang khas blangs rtags su bkod do zhes/ /thugs yus kyang mkhas pa'i grwa mi shogs/ /dus da res gzur na spyang po yin/ /yang kho bo'i rtsod spong du/ gsung las/ phyi ma 'di yi tshig gis ni/ /des na grub thob thams cad kyang / /phyogs re'i thabs kyis grol ba min/ /zhes pa'ang tshad ma'i bsal bar byas so zhes pa ni mi bden te/ dbang gis grol ba de phyogs re'i thabs kyis grol ba ma yin pa'i phyir ro zhes sogs bkod pa'i lan mchan bur/ phyogs re dbang ngam/ bskyed rim mam/ rdzogs rim gtum mo lta bu re res grol na gzhan phyogs re mi rnyed gsungs pa yang / phyogs snga'i dgongs bzhed cung zad thugs su ma tshud pa ste/

rab dbyer/ snga ma'i las 'phro'i bye brag dang / /nang gi rten 'brel khyad par gyis/ /ye shes skye ba'i sna 'dren ni/ /thabs kyi dbye bas byed par gsungs/ /zhes sogs ltar/ rlung gtum mo bskyed rim sogs re res ye shes skye ba'i sna 'dren byed kyang / de dag re re rkyang pas grol ba ni ma yin te/ grol ba mthong lam skye ba la kho rang skye ba'i rgyu rkyen nus pa kun tshang dgos pa'i phyir/ 'di dbang dus su grol ba dang mi mtshungs te/ dbang dus su rgyu rkyen nus pa kun tshang ba'i phyir/ dper na sa bon las myu gu skye ba la chu lud lta bu'i sna 'dren byas srid kyang / myu gu skye ba sa bon chu lud sogs rgyu rkyen nus pa kun tshang dgos pa bzhin zhes pa der snang ngo / /'bras skye ba'i rgyu rkyen ma 'dzom pa'i/ /rkyen re re ba la phyogs re zer/ /thabs gtum mo rlung sogs sna 'dren cing / /de rkyang pas grol ba min zhes bzhed/ /rgyud dbang bzhi rdzogs pa'i ye shes la/ /lam bskyed rdzogs thabs shes nus pa 'dzom/ /phyogs re re rkyang par ma shor bas/ /des grol ba thob ces sa lo gsung / /lha bskyed rim gtum mo rlung sogs la/ /rgyu rkyen sogs nus pa ma tshang bas/ /de re res grol ba min no zhes/ /chos rab dbyer gsungs de ma gsan nam/ /yang rab dbyer/ nā ro dang ni mai tri ba'i/ /phyag rgya chen po gang yin pa/ /de ni las dang chos dang ni/ /dam tshig dang ni phyag rgya che/ /gsang sngags rgyud las ji skad du/ /bshad pa de nyid khong bzhed do/ /zhes par gan mdzod las/ jo bo gnyis kyi lugs mthong bar de skad zer snyam na sbyar ba kho na ste zhes sogs dang / klu sgrub kyi phyag rgya bzhi pa'ang 'gros de ka yin pas/ bod du 'gyur ba'i chos lugs kun thos pa tsam du ma bzhag pa'ang tshig nyams tsam du zad do zhes bris snang ba la/ kho bo'i rtsod spong du/ nā ro mai tri gnyis phyag rgya bzhi'i rnam gzhag rgyud nas bshad pa bzhin mdzad gsungs pa la/

sun 'byin gnang ba ni/ khong gnyis ni phyag bzhi'i rgyud nas bshad pa bzhin mi mdzad gsung bar song 'dug go /zhes sogs bkod pa'i lan mchan bur/ de tsam la rtsod pa ci yin/ rab dbye bas bzhag pa'i go rim de dag paṇa chen gsum bzhed pa de min/ de'i rgyu mtshan lugs gsum kar phyag chen gsum pa dang / dam tshig bzhi par bshad 'dug pa 'brel legs par ltos/ zhes bris snang ba ni/ bltas kyang 'brel che bar ma khums/ rgyu mtshan rab dbye las/ phyag rgya bzhi po de nā ro mai tri gnyis kyang rgyud nas bshad pa bzhin mdzad gsungs pa tsam las khong gnyis kyang go rim 'di 'dra ba zhig mdzad gsung ba yang mi snang / rab dbye'i go rim ltar byas na/ rgyud bstan bcos dang 'gal bas rgyud dang mi mthun zhes kyang gsung bar mi spobs te/ phyag rgya bzhi po de la rgyud bstan bcos so sor/ go rim ngos 'dzin sbyor tshul mi 'dra ba mang dag gcig snang bas/ go rim mi mthun pa tsam la rtsod pa mi rigs zhes/ slar rtsod spong du bkod zin pa la/ slar yang go rim la rtsod pa yin gsungs pa tsam las nus pa mi snang bas lan gyi spobs pa gtugs par go /yang rtsod spong du/ de ltar go rim ngos 'dzin sogs mi mthun pa mang dag byung zhes pa'i lan mchan bur yang nges pa ci yod/ bzhi par byas pa dang / gsum par byas pa ma mthun zhes smra/ zhes bris snang ba yang / nus pa zad pa kho na'o/ /chos phyag rgya bzhi yi phyag chen de/ /grangs bzhi par bkod la nyes pa'i tshogs/ /skyon ci gzigs padma dkar po'i spyan/ /don ma sbas bstsal bar cis mi gnang / /yang rtsod spong du/ phyag rgya bzhi la rgyud bstan bcos so sor go rim mtha' dag pa zhig snang bas/ phyag chen phyag rgya gsum par dgos pa'i nges pa mi 'dug zhus pa'i lan mchan bur/ nges pa ci yod ces bris snang ba ni/ phyag chen phyag rgya gsum par byed dgos pa'i nges pa med na go /paṇa chen rnam gnyis kyang go rim de la thugs spro lang ba zhig min pa 'dra/

lam phyag rgya chen por grags pa de/ /grangs gsum par dgos pa'i nges med na/ /de bzhi par byas pa 'khrul zhes gtam/ /thugs yus kyi brnangs de'ang 'o re brgyal/ /yang kho bo'i rtsod spong du/ nā ro mai tri gnyis car gyi lung drangs pa der/ phyag rgya bzhi'i zlas phye ba'i phyag chen de ni/ chos kyi phyag rgya la brten pa dang / de yang las kyi phyag rgya la brten dgos gsungs pa la/ khyed cag mdo dang / rgyud sde 'og ma rang rkang gi phyag chen yang bzhed pas/ lung gnod byed du song zhes bkod pa'i lan chan bur/ las dang chos dang phyag rgya che/ /dam tshig ces bya 'od gsal nyid/ /zer ba'i lung rnam snang mngon byang du'ang byung / rgyud sde 'og ma'i lung gong mar 'dren mi rigs na/ klu sgrub yab sras kyis/ 'ja' tshon lta bu'i lus ngag gi /de nyid sgom pas thob par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs mang du gsungs zhes bris snang ba ni/ rgyud sde gong 'og thun mong ba'i lung skabs su gang bab drang du rung bas de 'dra mi rung zhes ci zhu/ 'on kyang rang rang thun mong min pa de ma 'chol bar byed pa nged kyi lugs/ rnam snang mngon byang dang / rnal 'byor rgyud du'ang / phyag rgya bzhi'i ming dang kho rang skabs kyi don ngos 'dzin re'ang 'byung yang / rnal 'byor bla med dang ming mthun la don mi 'dra bas/ de dag la 'khrul na mkhas pa'i grangs su ci 'gro/ de dag sgra ji bzhin par gzung du ga la rung ste/ gong ma'i thun mong ma yin pa de 'og mar 'byung don med cing / thun mong ma yin pa bsre mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ /rgyud 'og mar phyag rgya rnam bzhi'i don/ /dngos tshang na gong 'og zab khyad 'chol/ /don 'gal med gong 'og lung rigs kyis/ /gsal nus na lung 'dren su yis 'gog /rgyud gong 'og phyag rgya rnam bzhi'i don/ /dug bdud rtsir bsres nas 'thung ba mkhan/ /chos zab don srog la mi brtsi yang / /rang sku 'tsho stongs na mi 'gyod dam/

/yang gan mdzod las/ klu sgrub kyi phyag rgya bzhi pa'i lung 'dren gsal por gnang ba la/ rtsod spong du/ lung de rnams rang la gnod byed du song ste/ lung der mi phyed pa'i phyag rgya chen po chos kyi phyag chen las 'byung dgos par sa lu'i sa bon las sa myug 'byung ba'i dpes bstan/ khyed cag chos kyi phyag rgya'i ming tsam yang ma tshor bar phyag chen du ming btags tshad phyag chen du khas ches ba'i phyir zhes bkod pa'i lan mchan bur/ sngon la chos kyi phyag rgya dgongs pa zhig mdzad nas gsungs na 'o mi brgyal ba 'dra zhes gsungs pa ni/ phyag rgya bzhi la 'jog mtshams dang grangs go rim ngos 'dzin mi 'dra ba mang dag snang bas mgo 'khor sbyong du bcug pa yang thugs mad de/ de bas kyang dngos btags gtan nas ma phyed par ming btags tshad dngos su zhal gyis bzhes pas thugs rnam dpyod gron du song zhing 'chugs che ba 'di phangs par snang ngo / /chos phyag rgya bzhi yi rnam grangs mang / /don dngos btags phyed na spyang po yin/ /khong g.yon zhar ma yi lta stangs kyis/ /phyogs g.yon gyi me tog chun po bor/ /chos phyag rgya'i tha snyad mgo 'khor yang / /gtam drang smra mgrin pa ngal gsung mad/ /de mkhyen yang don min skyog pa'i gsung / /don 'di ka yin nam mgu ri shi/ /yang rab dbyer/ dbang bskur bzhi pa ma thob par/ /phyag rgya chen po sogs sgom dang / /zhes par gan mdzod las/ 'di tshig spoms so/ /rgyu mtshan phyag rgya chen po'i sgra ni/ spyod rgyud rnal 'byor rgyud du'ang bshad la/ de dag tsam zhog rnal 'byor chen po de nyid 'dus par/ rnam par snang mdzad phyag rgya che/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mtshan pa 'o/ /zhes bskyed rim la phyag chen du bzhag pa dang / zhes sogs mang du snang ba la/ rtsod spong du rab dbye'i gzhung der ni/ dbang bzhi pa ma thob par mtshon bya don gyi phyag chen mi 'byung bas don de ka yin yang /

de ma thob par mtshon byed dpe'i phyag chen skye ba yang yod pas/ 'khrul gzhi skye ba yang mad mod/ sgrub byed lung 'dren de dag ni/ phyag chen du ming btags tshad phyag chen du khas blangs pa dang / mthar mi blun po la ba lang zhes ming btags pa'i mi de yang ba lang yin zhes khas blang dgos 'byung ngo zhes smra ba la lan mchan bur/ gang du phyag chen du ming btags pa de/ de skabs su khas mi len na btags nas ci bya/ de thams cad gcig tu khas ma blangs pas/ la lar lag pa'i phyag rgya/ bskyed rim sogs dmigs bsal mang du 'dug pa la/ bad rlung gis skyon du gyur ces bris snang ba ni/ spyir bka' bstan bcos kyi babs 'gros la/ ming de la dngos ming dang btags ming gnyis/ dngos ming la bshad 'jug mu gsum/ btags ming la 'dra 'brel rgyu mtshan du byas pa sogs mang dag yod pas/ dngos btags phye dgos pa zhig mkhas pa'i spyi lugs yin yang / khong phyag chen pa la rbad kham de tsam los yod/ ming btags tshad la dngos btags mi dgos par/ phyag chen du ming btags pa'i nyon mongs pa de ni phyag chen/ sangs rgyas su ming btags pa'i tha mal skye bo de ni sangs rgyas/ seng ger ming btags pa'i mi de ni seng ge glang chen du ming btags pa'i sangs rgyas de ni glang chen sogs phyag rgya chen po'i klong yangs kyi rnam 'phrul ngo mtshar ba'i gtam bsam las 'das/ bad rlung langs pa'i rtog ge sbugs 'thum khyod la de rang mkho/ nad bad rlung langs pa'i phyal phyol de/ gzhan gso rig mkhas na 'tsho ba'ang srid/ /chos phyag chen myos pa'i 'ur shang 'di/ /khong rgyal rnams 'dzom yang dka' se ba/ /phyag chen ming rkyang smig sgyu gsar ba'i thang / /nyam chung ri dwags chur sred brel ba'i lce/ /don med grog skam mya ngam thang la 'khyams/ /rig rig mig gis bltas kyang skyabs med do/ /yang rtsod spong du rang la khas blangs nang 'gal 'byung ste/ 'dir bskyed rim dang las rgya sogs phyag chen du khas blangs nas/

'og tu rang lugs kyi phyag chen ngos 'dzin pa'i tshe/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la ngos bzung 'dug pa'i phyir/ zhes zhus pa'i lan mchan bur/ bskyed rim la phyag rgya bzhir gsungs pa'i phyag chen de skabs su sgom mi dgos par thal ba la lan rlon zhes bris pa ni/ cir yang ma 'brel te/ phyag chen la shes phyin yin pa zhig dgos na/ bskyed rim dang las rgya yang shes phyin du thal te/ phyag chen yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas blangs zhes pa la/ lan dngos mi gnang bar/ bskyed rim skabs su phyag chen sgom mi dgos par thal/ bskyed rim phyag chen ma yin pa'i phyir gsung bar snang bas/ mkhas rnams dges pa'i dga' ston du mar gyur tam/ yang rab dbyer/ dbang bskur dag dang ma 'brel ba/ /de la phyag rgya chen po bkag /ces par gan mdzod las/ dgag pa'i gzhung ma dmigs pa dang / mdo rang lam nas 'tshang rgya ba dang 'gal ba dang / gzhi phyag rgya chen po yul thon gsung ba'i skyon gsum gnang ba la/ rtsod spong du/ dbang dang ma 'brel ba la phyag chen ye shes skye ba'i lung gang yang med pas lung gis bka' bar yang song / mdo rang lam las 'tshang rgya ba khas mi len zhing / khas len na yang / de'i ye shes de phyag chen yin pa mi 'thad pa dang / gzhi phyag chen gyi tha snyad khas mi len/ len na yang de phyag chen ma yin pas/ phyag chen ye shes skye ba la dbang dang 'brel ba dgos byas pa la/ phyag chen ma yin pa'i skyon gtong 'brel med yin zhus pa'i lan mchan bur/ mdo rang lam gyis sangs rgyas pa zhig yod na ni/ de'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes phyag rgya chen po dngos grub ces bzhag pa de ma yin na/ sangs rgyas go ma chod/ de 'dra sangs rgyas pa'i lugs la ni mi srid/ deng sang byang phyogs kyi srang dbar na gtam skad de 'dra yod srid/ gzhi phyag rgya chen po la dbang dang 'brel ma 'brel mi yong / bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ thog ma med pa'i chos nyid ni/

/'phel 'grib med pas gnas pa yin/ /gsungs/ rtsod gzhi la gnas pa lam nyams su len pa la/ gsang sngags las dbang la rag las par gsungs la/ dbang de la jo bo a ti sha'i dam tshig bsdus pa las/ rig pa rtsal gyi dbang sogs bshad pas/ 'di dag khong du tshud pa la/ rgyud sde la sbyangs pa byed dgos pa 'dra gsungs te/ 'di rnam dpyod phyug cing rgyud sde la sbyangs pa zhig gi gtam ni gtan nas mi 'dra/ rgyu mtshan phyag chen mchog gi dngos grub ma thob pa'i sangs rgyas shig 'dod na de go ma chod yin pa dang / de 'dra nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i lugs la ni med gsungs pa ni/ sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' mtha' dag thugs su ma byon pa ste/ nang pa'i grub mtha' smra ba bye smra sogs bzhi rang rang lam nas sangs rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas re bzhed kyang / de dag phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i sangs rgyas yin zhes khas len pa de dag gi lugs su la yang med pa dang / skabs don rtsod spong du/ gsang sngags kyi skabs 'dir/ mdo rang rkang las 'tshang rgya ba khas mi len/ khas len na yang zhes pa'i tshig gi nus pa las shes/ dpal ldan sa skya sngags lugs la ngor rdzong gnyis zhes grags/ rdzong lugs bo dong pa dang bcas pa mdo rang rkang las sa dang po tsam yang thob pa med gsungs/ ngor lugs bla ma sa chen gyi lam 'jug ldog ltar mdo rang lam nas sa bcu pa man bgrod srid kyang / sngags lugs pas sa bcu gcig pa dang sa bcu gnyis pa slob pa'i sa dang / bcu gsum gong ma mi slob pa sangs rgyas kyi sa yin pas/ sa de gsum sbas pa'i sa yin pa'i gnad kyis phar phyin rang rkang pas bgrod mi nus zhes 'chad pas/ byang phyogs chos rgyal dri ma med pa'i dpung pa'i grib bsil la bde bar 'tsho ba'i nor 'dzin dag pa'i zhing khams 'di ni/ go ma chod kyi sangs rgyas kyi gtam de 'dra sngar yang mi grag cing / phyis kyang 'byung bar ga la 'gyur te/

bstan pa'i snying po rnal mar gnas pas so/ /khyed cag gis gal te khas len na yang de'i ye shes phyag chen min/ zhes pa thugs su ma shong bar snang yang / de go ma chod dam/ go chod drags pa'i hang gtam yin nam/ gtam gsar de 'dra phyogs 'di na mi snang / sku gzhogs nye sar lkog lab di ri ri yod pa 'dra ste/ mdo rang rkang las sangs rgya ba zhig ni yod ces grag des phyag chen mchog gi dngos grub thob na/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa/ rig ma'i skyes bu/ yab yum zhal sbyor gyi nyams len/ bskyed rdzogs zab don sogs/ gsang sngags bla med sbas don zab mo'i gnad rnams brnyed dgos par song ste rnyed rnyed mi 'dra/ ma rnyed na ni go ma chod kyi sangs rgyas khong sku bzhogs na zab don gsan pa la yod thang / gal te rnyed do gsung gin gda' na ni/ bla med sbas don gyi bang mdzod la chom rkun shor ram/ yang na mdo rang rkang pa dag rkang ma tshugs te bla med sngags la 'dres sam/ yang na ma rnyed kyang rnyed gtam brag cha'i sgra dbyangs rna ba'i bdud rtsir zhen pa'i skyon no/ /mdo rang rkang sangs rgyas zhal brdzun mkhan/ /don bsam yas go 'phang ma rnyed kyang / /bdag bla med lam 'ongs rdor 'dzin zhes/ /brdzun gzhan gyis bslab pa ma yin nam/ /gzhi phyag chen la dbang dang 'brel ma 'brel med na/ lam dus dang 'bras dus kyi gzhi phyag chen gcig yod dam med/ yod na de yang dbang dang ma 'brel bar song zhing / med na gzhi 'bras lhun grub ces sogs dang 'gal ba min nam/ gsang sngags las gzhi la gnas pa/ lam du nyams su len pa dbang la rag las na bla med lam gyi snying po phyag chen ye shes dbang dang 'brel dgos pa la skyon gtong brgya phrag gis ci mdzad/ jo bo'i rig pa rtsal gyi dbang zhes pa'ang ming tsam las sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba'i smin byed kyi dbang mtshan nyid pa ga la yin gsung na rang la 'khor te/ skal ldan cig car ba la dbang mi dgongs gsungs pa dang /

yang sngags sngags nyams su len pa dbang la rag las/ de yang rig pa rtsal dbang lta bu smin byed mtshan nyid pa zhig dgos zhes bkas bcad pa'i phyir ro/ /khong go ma chod kyi sangs rgyas shig /phyogs byang na 'dug ces ri bong cal/ /yul shar na bzhugs pa bden yang zer/ /go chod chod 'ud kyi slus kyang lo/ /mdo rang rkang ma ri tsi thang na/ /nor smig rgyu las gzhan chu mi rnyed/ /chos sbas don bcud kyi skal ba ci/ /gsung 'khyog bral nges don rtsal na tshim/ /yang rtsod spong du mtshon bya don gyi phyag chen skye ba la bla med dbang thob dgos te/ rgyud sde chen po gzhan dag phar zhog ye shes snying po zhes bya ba'i rgyud nyung ngu zhig las kyang / 'di ltar zhes sogs lung gsal po de phul ba'i lan mchan bur/ rgyud sde chen po de phar bzhag pa'i skyon ga byung bar gda'o/ /zhes dang / ye shes snying po 'di dang / ra li sogs tshad ldan min zer ba yod ces/ phyag chen khro zhal cung zad bstan pa'i thugs sun gnang ba/ kyang sgra'i nus pa ma dgongs 'dug kyang / tshig 'khris tsam la rtsod rin ci chog zhal rlangs drag tu 'phyur bas/ ye snying rgyud rnam dag la gshegs gsol snang ba 'dra na'ang / de ga la rigs/ bka'i zur phra 'phog dgos pa'i tshig rgyud de na mi snang / ci ste rgyud de na/ mtshon bya don gyi phyag chen/ chos kyi phyag chen sogs mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes las skye ba dang / de yang las kyi phyag rgya'i ming can dngos sam ye shes kyi phyag rgya la brten nas rnyed dgos pa dang / las rgya de rten pa la yang dbang thob dgos par bshad pa 'di las tshar bcad snang ba yin na ni/ de 'dra ni bla med kyi rgyud phal che ba dang / nā ro mai tri sogs dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos shas cher na yod pas/ de thams cad phar cam bzhog cig de nas ngos gnang dgos nyen gda'o/ /rgyud ye shes snying po'i zhing sa la/ /lam phyag rgya bzhi yi lo tog smin/

/sngon bsags ldan dga' bde longs spyod la/ /gzhan phrag dog rdzun zhus gsan mi rigs/ /rgyud ye snying 'chi med gzhon nu la/ /skyon yod med khyed thugs dag pas mkhyen/ /gzhan rgyus med g.yon gtam mi gsan par/ /khong nag med gnang dbyung mi gnang 'tshal/ /lha bdud rtsi lha min gyis brkus 'tshang / /bu zla bas gtol ba'i le lan gyis/ /nag nyes bral nyi gzhon gza' yis gzung / /kun ra 'da' sbron pa ma dgongs sam/ /yang rtsod spong du/ gzhi phyag chen gyi tha snyad khas mi len/ khas len na yang des phyag chen gyi go mi chod/ chod na rang nyid la nang 'gal 'byung ste/ phyag chen ngos 'dzin gyi tshe/ drang nges mthar thug gsum gyi mthar thug yin/ shes phyin yin/ bde dgyes dus 'khor sogs yin zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal zhes pa'i lan mchan bur/ gsang sngags la rgyu 'bras sam gzhi 'bras lhun grub tu spyod pa zhes pa zhig 'byung / rgyud sde rnams kyi mtshan don tsam yang ma bltas par khral spyod du 'ongs pa legs so/ /zhes bris snang ngo / /'o na rgyu 'bras lhun grub byas pas/ rgyu 'bras bu yin/ 'bras bu rgyu yin zhes pa'am/ yang na rgyu dus na 'bras bu/ 'bras dus na rgyu yod gsung ngam/ yang gzhi 'bras lhun grub byas pas/ gzhi 'bras bu/ 'bras bu gzhi yin gsung ngam gsung na ni phyag rgya chen po 'chol/ mi gsung na ni rtsod lan 'brel ci/ rgyu mtshan/ gzhi phyag chen gyis phyag chen gyi go chod na/ phyag chen ngos 'dzin tshe/ mthar thug shes phyin/ bde dges dus 'khor sogs la ngos bzung bas/ ma dag pa gzhi'i phyag chen de yang / mthar thug shes phyin/ bde dges sogs su 'gyur zhes pa'i lan du/ rgyu 'bras lhun grub gzhi 'bras lhun grub ces gsung ba de/ rta thul gyis ni tshangs pa la/ /'byung chen gang du 'gag ces dris/ /mes por rlom pa'i snye ma yis/ /dris lan rlung la bskur dang mtshungs/ /ces pa der song /

ci ste rgyud kyi mtshan don tsam yang ma bltas par khral spyod gsungs pa de myangs na/ rgyud kyi mtshan btags tshad de dang de mtshan nyid pa yin gsung zhig 'dra na/ de 'dra min las che/ rgyud kyi mtshan don 'chad shes pa rnams rgyu rgyud kyai rdo rje/ thabs rgyud kyai rdo rje/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyud tshig 'bras rgyud kyai rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol ba'i snga ma rgyu rgyud sogs la/ kyai rdo rje zhes mtshan 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan/ btags pa'i dgos pa/ dngos la gnod byed gsum tshang bas rgyu rgyud gzhung lam sogs kyai rdo rje btags pa ba yin/ phyi ma de la dngos la gnod byed med pas mtshan nyid pa yin zhes zer mchis/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gsung gi gsang ba zab mo'i mdzod nas skyes pa dang / phyogs gzhan du khral sprod dgos pa ni/ ci la 'char/ 'on kyang skyes bu dam pa la tsam bu ma yin par snying nas dad pa'i lha phyag 'di rgyang nas 'tshal lo/ /tshig 'gal 'dur rtsod cing brgal ba'i lan/ /gzhi rgyu 'bras lhun grub yin no skad/ /sngon 'jig rten mes po'i rnam thar des/ /lan drang po'i bden tshig dbyings su yal/ /rgyud mtshan don ma rnyed khral 'jal gsung / /bka' skyon yang byin rlabs snying la 'jug /mtshan btags tshad mtshan nyid par bzhed tshe/ /rgyud mtshan don rnyed de'ang a re blun/ /yang rtsod spong du/ chos dbyings rang bzhin rnam dag tsam gyis sangs rgyas dngos kyi go mi chod pa dang / shes rab pha rol phyin gnyis med/ /ces sogs kyi lung drangs nas/ gzhung lam sher phyin gyis sher phyin gyi go mi chod zhus pa la/ lan mchan bur/ 'di yang deng sang drang nges mi 'byed par de skad smra ste/ de dag sher phyin btags pa/ btags pa'i dgos pa med par song gsung ba bris so/ /phyogs glang gi gzhung gsal po de la de 'dra'i gsung 'byon pa e rigs/ gzhung sher phyin dang lam sher phyin grangs bzhin/

sher phyin dngos brjod bya dang / 'thob byar byed pa dgongs gzhi yin/ gzhung sher phyin la thos bsam sgom gsum dang / lam sher phyin nyams su blangs pas/ mthar thug 'bras bu sher phyin dngos 'byung ba dgos pa/ de gnyis 'bras dus kyi sangs rgyas ye shes dngos min pas gnod byed tshang gsung ba mkhas pa spyi'i skad/ chos sher phyin dngos btags rab phye yang / /de mi mkhyen brdzu ba'i tshul ston pa/ /lha pad mig mi thub gzugs bsgyur nas/ /gzhan stobs ldan bslu bar mi mdzad dam/ /yang rtsod spong du/ gti mug dang zhe sdang sogs phyag chen mtshan nyid pa yin na ni ha cang thal ches/ min na ni gong gi sun 'byin la 'brel med/ ces pa'i lan mchan bur/ rtogs pa rnams la chos skur 'char gyis/ lan gyi go chod gsung ba/ nyon mongs chos sku'i zhal bzhes bka' drin che/ 'khor ba pa thams cad 'bad med du grol mchis/ sgrub byed gtan tshigs de ni mi 'grub par snang ste/ rtogs pa la nyon mongs pa 'bras dus kyi chos sku lta ci/ rang bzhin chos sku zhes pa rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos dbyings tsam du'ang ga la 'char te/ bka' brgyud gong ma'i gsung de rigs rnal 'byor pa rtogs pa cher ldan pa la/ sngar nyon mongs chags sdang skye ba'i yul de la/ phyis dran 'dzin lta bas zin pa'i tshe/ chags sogs nyon mongs mi skye ba'am/ skyes kyang chu bur ltar rang grol du song ba tsam la dgongs/ de tsam sa dkar sogs gong ma dgongs dbyings gcig 'jam mgon bla ma sa skya pa chen pos kyang / rnam par rtog pa ye shes kyi/ /dbang du song na 'khor ba med/ /ye shes rnam par rtog pa yi/ /dbang du song na grol ba med/ /ces gsungs pa lags/ tshig de dag gi mdun pa bkrol ma shes par/ sgra zin gyi skud sne log pa nas 'then na ske 'gags te srog dang 'bral mchi/ sems gzhan 'gyu bsam pa ma brtags par/ /gsung snyan snyan khrus mkhan dul nyams la/

/bag phab na byi ba srog rtsa 'phrog /ro mngar mtshungs dug la zhen dang mtshungs/ /khong rgyal dang pan grub gong ma'i gsung / /chos drang nges dgongs pa ma rnyed par/ /tshig ji bzhin don la mngon zhen na/ /blo nyams zhes mi pham mgon des gsungs/ /yang rab dbyer/ blun pos phyag rgya che sgom pa/ /phal cher dud 'gro'i rgyu ru gsungs/ /zhes par gan mdzod las/ phyogs chos rang gis ma gzigs par/ gzhan la ston pa'i ngag tu 'dug pas grangs can gyi ring lugs 'dzin rgyud grang / ring lugs de ni rnam 'grel du/ bdag mthong min yang zhes sogs kyis bkag zin to/ /rang nyid kyis mthong ngo zhe na rang la gnod de/ phyag rgya chen po dbang bzhi pa thob nas ston rgyu/ de'i gdul bya ni dbang po rnon por nges pas so zhes dang / bdag nyid kyis mthong na rang la gnod ces pa'i lan mchan bur/ blun pos phyag chen sgom pa yod na zhes bris snang yang / rab dbye'i dgongs pa ni/ phyag chen ngos ma zin par phyag chen du rlom nas sgom pa zhig la gsungs par snang / khyed cag phyag chen sgom pa la phyag chen ye shes skyes pa zhig dgos pa dang / dbang bzhi pa thob pa la dbang rnon zhig dgos gsung ba e yin/ snga ma ltar na ni phyag chen sgom pa'i 'khrid dmigs bstan tsam nas phyag chen ye shes skye dgos pa dang / yang na de ma skyes bar du sgom khrid bstan kyang de sgom mkhan min dgos par song / phyi ma ltar na ni/ dbang bzhi thob pa'i skal dman rim 'jug pa gtan mi srid pa 'dug go /khong blun pos phyag chen mi sgom gsungs/ /gzhan chad stong stong nyid lta yin gsungs/ /don dngos po min yang rlom tshod tsam/ /de bden no gsung na gnyis ka mtshungs/ /yang gan mdzod de la rtsod spong du/ 'o na klu sgrub kyis/ stong pa nyid la lta nyes na/ /zhes sogs kyang phyogs chos rang gis ma grub pa gzhan la ston par song bar thal te/ stong pa nyid la lta ba'i lta ba ni rnam dag yin pa dang /

zhes sogs bkod pa'i lan mchan bur/ chad stong yod pa gang du lta yang dug yin rnam dag ci/ /zhes bris pa ni/ chad stong dang yod mthar lta ba'i lta ba de/ stong pa nyid la lta ba'i lta ba yin na/ stong nyid/ chos nyid/ de bzhin nyid rnams rnam grangs yin pas chad stong du lta ba de/ chos nyid de bzhin nyid la lta bar yang song bas dbu ma'i lta bar thal lo/ /ci ste stong nyid la lta ba'i lta ba la/ stong nyid rtogs mi dgos gsung na/ blun pos phyag chen sgom pa yang sus 'gog sems khros pa'i drang srong dmod pa'i sems/ /gzhan nyes med bsreg pa ma bzod nas/ /mgo skyes pa'i ral khur ngo tsha bzhin/ /rang skyes gnas bor nas sa la thim/ /mgon 'gran zla bral ba'i dam pa der/ /sems ma dad rnyog pa'i rdul med kyang / /tshig sbyor ba rab rtog kha nas shor/ /'di nyams ldan yin yang mkhas la gshegs/ /yang gan mdzod las/ ma rtogs pa'i skabs/ rtogs pa shar ba'i skabs/ mthar thug gi skabs gsum mam/ so skye/ byang 'phags/ sangs 'phags kyi skabs gsum du phye nas/ gnas skabs gnyis pa der/ rnam rtog chos sku/ dug lnga ye shes lnga sogs khas len gsungs pa la/ rtsod spong du/ rnam rtog chos sku yin na/ rnam rtog kyang yin/ chos sku yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun zhig dgos pa las/ de 'dra ba de gnas skabs gsum po gang du yang mi srid do/ /zhes sogs bkod la lan mchan bur/ byams chos ne tso'i 'don pa byed pa dag /mdo sde rgyan gyi/ de bzhin nyid dmigs ye shes ni/ /rnam pa tha dad med sgom zhing / /yod dang med don mngon sum pa/ /rnam rtog dbang 'byor nyid ces bya/ /'grel par/ rnam pa tha dad med pa sgom pa ni/ mtshan ma dang de bzhin nyid dag tha mi dad pa nyid du mthong ba'i phyir ro/ /'dis ni nyan thos kyi mtshan ma med pa las/ byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan ma med pa/ khyed zhugs pa yongs su bstan te/ de dag gi mtshan ma dang / mtshan ma med pa dag tha dad nyid du mthong bas/

mtshan ma tha dad yid la mi byed pa dang / mtshan ma med pa'i dbyings yid la mi byed pa'i sgo nas mtshan ma med pa la snyoms par 'jug go /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni/ de bzhin nyid las ma gtogs pa'i mtshan ma ma mthong bas/ mtshan ma med pa mthong ste/ de'i phyir de dag gi ye shes ni rnam pa tha dad med par sgom pa yin no/ /yod pa'i de bzhin nyid dang / med pa'i don mngon sum pa ste/ rnam par rtog pa ji lta ba don thams cad 'grub pa'i sgo nas/ rnam par rtog pa la dbang 'byor ba 'di nyid thob pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam par rtog pa la dbang 'byor ba nyid ces bya'o zhes pa gzigs 'tshal lo zhes bris snang ba ni/ rnam rtog chos sku'i sgrub byed gsal po'o snyam du dgongs kyang / mdo rgyan lta ba'i don ma rtogs par/ de bzhin nyid dang mtshan ma tha mi dad ces dang / rnam rtog la dbang 'byor zhes pa'i tshig tsam la thugs 'dzol mchis/ 'di'i lta ba ci snyam na/ 'di rtogs pa la/ lta ba'i rtogs bya chos dbyings de bzhin nyid don dam bden pa khyad chos lnga ldan 'di rtogs dgos pas/ de yang mdo rgyan las/ yod min med min de bzhin min gzhan min/ /skye dang 'jig med 'bri bar mi 'gyur zhing / /'phel ba med cing rnam par dag pa'ang med/ /rnam par dag 'gyur 'di ni don dam mtshan/ /zhes pa ltar/ gzung 'dzin gyis kun btags pa ltar yod pa ma yin/ gzung 'dzin gyis stong pa'i de bzhin nyid du med pa ma yin/ gzhan dbang yang dag pa ma yin pa'i kun rtog gi chos nyid de chos can gzhan dbang kun rtog dang / de bzhin min pa ste gcig kyang ma yin/ gzhan min pa ste tha dad pa yang ma yin/ dbyings de skye 'jig dang 'phel 'grib med pa dang / da lta glo bur dri mas bsgribs pa'i phyir na rnam par dag pa'ang med/ gnyen pos sbyangs na phyis dri ma dag par yang 'gyur zhes pa'i khyad par chos kyi nang tshan de bzhin min gzhan min zhes pa'i don/

gzhan dbang rnam rtog de/ kho rang gi chos nyid de yin zhes pa lta bu'i sgo nas gcig kyang ma yin/ chos nyid de chos can kun rtog de'i ngo bo yin pas de las gzhan pa'am tha dad pa yang ma yin/ gnad des na de rtogs pa'i lta ba des kyang / rnam rtog dang chos nyid gcig min gzhan min du rtogs kyang / rnam rtog chos sku mtshan nyid pa lta ci smos/ rang bzhin chos sku tsam du yang rtogs par mi snang ste/ lta ba mnyam bzhag de'i ngang na rnam rtog 'khrul pa nub nas med pas so/ /'di'i skabs su nyan thos dang theg chen lta ba tha dad yin pas/ nyan thos pa dag gis/ mnyam gzhag tu mtshan ma bkag tsam las/ mtshan med chos nyid kyi don ma rtogs pas/ mtshan med rtogs pa'i lta ba la khyad par 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin/ chos nyid 'di rtogs pa'i mnyam gzhag tu/ gzhan dbang rnam rtog gi snang ba nub cing / rjes thob tu lta ba des zin pas snang ba rmi lam sgyu ma ltar 'char bas rnam par rtog pa la dbang 'byor zhes pa'i gnad kyang de yin/ de ltar shes tshe/ de bzhin nyid dmigs ye shes ni/ /zhes sogs rtsa 'grel gyi mdud pa des grol/ rnam rtog chos skur dgugs kyang re thag de nas chad do/ /gzhung byams chos ne tso'i 'don pa zhes/ /bka' lci yang tshig don mdud pa grol/ /chos thos bsam lta bar gdeng thob tsam/ /sgom mnyam 'jog gnad 'gag gzhan na'ang dkon/ /gnad des na bka' bstan bcos mkhas grub gong ma'i gsung la dgongs don 'tshol ba'i gnad ma shes par/ tshig zin tsam zhig bskyangs pas ga la rung ste/ mdo las ma rig pa byang chub/ nyon mongs lam byed/ tshags sogs nyon mongs chos dbyings yin zer ba lta bu'i tshig zin yod kyang / de'i dgongs don byams mgon gyis bkral ba ltar shes dgos te/ de yang mdo las/ ma rig pa dang byang chub ni gcig go zhes dang / 'dod chags las ma gtogs par 'dod chags las nges par 'byung bar nga mi smra'o/

/zhes sogs dang / lhag bsam bstan par/ kun dga' bo 'dod chags las g.yo bar mi bya'o/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid mi g.yo ba'i don gyis 'dod chags nyid chos kyi dbyings yin pa'i phyir ro zhes sogs tshig zin la de ltar bstan kyang / de lta bu ma 'ongs pa'i skye bo blo gros zhan pa dag 'khrul gzhi byung dogs/ thugs rje dang byams pa'i bdag nyid rgyal tshab ma pham pas dogs pa bkod/ dgongs pa blangs pa'i 'khrul sel 'di gsungs te/ mdo rgyan las/ chos kyi dbyings ni ma rtogs par/ /gang phyir chos med de yi phyir/ /kun nas nyon mongs bstan pa la/ /blo ldan dgongs pa de yin 'dod/ /ces dang / gang phyir chags sogs de nyid la/ /tshul bzhin 'jug pas de yi phyir/ /de las rnam grol 'gyur des na/ /de yis de dag la nges 'byung / /zhes dang / chos kyi dbyings ni ma gtogs par/ /gang phyir chos med de yi phyir/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis de dag la/ /nges 'byung chags sogs yin par dgongs/ /zhes dang / 'gal par dbyig gnyen gyis/ ma rig pa dang byang chub ni gcig go zhes nyon mongs pa bstan pa der yang / dgongs pa ni de kho na yin te/ ma rig pa dang byang chub kyi chos nyid la nye bar btags pa'i phyir zhes ma rig pa la chos dbyings kyis khyab pas/ ma rig pa'i chos nyid de/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi byang chub yin pa la dgongs nas/ ma rig pa dang byang chub gcig ces gsungs kyi/ ma rig pa dngos byang chub yin pa'i don min zhes gsungs 'dug pa dang / gzhung 'og ma'i 'grel par/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dod chags las ma gtogs par 'dod chags las nges par 'byung bar nga mi smra'o zhes pa de'i dgongs pa ston te/ chos nyid las ma gtogs pa'i chos med pa de'i phyir ro/ /'dod chags la sogs pa'i chos nyid kyang 'dod chags la sogs pa'i ming thob la/ de yang 'dod chags la sogs pa las nges par 'byung ba yin pas/

de la dgongs pa ni de yin par rig par bya'o zhes nyon mongs chags sogs kyi rang bzhin de chos dbyings yin pas/ chos dbyings las ma gtogs pa'i chos med ces pa'i don yang de yin/ 'dod chags nyid chos kyi dbyings yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i tshig zin ltar/ 'dod chags gnyis snang de chos dbyings yin zer ba min/ 'dod chags kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal de chos dbyings yin pas/ de la thos bsam sgom pas gnad du bsnun na/ nyon mongs chags sogs sun dbyung nus zhes pa'i don yin gyi/ chags sogs dngos lam du song ba min zhes byams pas bka' bstsal pa der gda'/ ri bong cal gyi rjes la dam pa khyed 'o brgyal mchis/ chu gting ring khron pa'i gzugs brnyan la/ /don ma brtags mchongs pa'i seng phrug bzhin/ /gnad ma rig tshig 'bru snyug ldem la/ /sems khyung chen chags na shog pa 'chag /chos rnam rtog chos sku yin min la/ /sras rgyal tshab dam pa thugs rgyus che/ /gzhan rtogs ldan snang glu kyur kyur la/ /thugs a 'thas snang na grub mtha' 'jig /yang rtsod spong du/ gnas skabs dang po der/ bden gnyis dang 'khrul ma 'khrul sogs tha dad so sor khas len/ gnas skabs gnyis pa 'dir bden gnyis dbyer med/ thabs shes dbyer med sogs khas len gsung ba la rnam dpyad med de/ theg chen skabs su bden gnyis khas len pa de srid du/ bden gnyis dbyer med yin zhes khas blang dgos shing / de khas blangs kyang / kun rdzob kun rdzob dang / don dam bden pa don dam bden pa dang / 'khrul pa 'khrul pa sogs rnam gzhag ma 'chol bar khas len dgos pa'i phyir zhus pa la/ lan mchan bur/ kun rdzob bden pa dang / don dam bden pa'i gzhi mthun mi srid pa tha dad kyi sgrub byed spyi gtam du ga la 'gro zhes bris gnang ba ni/ gnad ma dgongs/ gzhi mthun mi srid tsam tha dad dam gzhan yin pa'i sgrub byed du ga la 'god/ gnas skabs gnyis par bden gnyis dbyer med sogs kyi gnad kyis rnam rtog chos sku yin gsung ba na/

bden gnyis 'khrul ma 'khrul dbyer med yin pas/ 'khrul pa ma 'khrul ba/ kun rdzob bden pa don dam bden pa yin zhes pa yang khas blang dgos/ de khas blangs na 'khor ba myang 'das yin pa sogs ha cang thal bas/ bden gnyis 'khor 'das stong gzhi'i chos can dang / chos nyid stong pa sogs dbyer med dang / tha mi dad pa dang / gzhan ma yin zhes khas blangs kyang / de dag gzhi mthun yod pa dang / gcig cig shos de yin zhes khas blang du mi rung zhes zhus pa lags pas/ dgongs dbyings zhib dpyod 'tshal lo/ /des na gnas skabs gnyis par rnam rtog chos sku yin gsungs pa ni/ gnas skabs dang po las gnas skabs gnyis pa gzigs snang log par song ste/ gnas skabs gnyis par rnam rtog chos sku/ 'khor ba myang 'das/ kun rdzob don dam sogs su log par mthong / gnas skabs dang por/ rnam rtog rnam rtog 'khor ba 'khor ba/ kun rdzob kun rdzob sogs yin bab bzhin mthong 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te de ltar na/ 'di la ro mi zhim pa ro mchog snang dang / zhing ma dag pa dag par snang sogs la'ang mtshungs so snyam na/ tshig zin gyi dgongs pa bkrol ma shes na bden yang / skye bo phal pa la ro mi zhim pa dang / zhing ma dag par snang ba'i gzhi zhig de dag gi skyon sbyangs nas ro zhim pa dang / zhing dag par snang ba yin gyi/ ro mi zhim pa dngos dang / zhing ma dag pa dngos/ ro zhim pa dang / zhing dag par snang ba ma yin pa'i phyir/ dper na nad kyi tshor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgyu sman gyis bcos nas/ lus tshor ram sems tshor bde ba skyes pa'i tshe/ lus tshor sdug bsngal de tshor ba bde bar snang ba ma yin no/ /sras 'phags pa'i rjes thob gzigs snang de/ /khong zla grags kun rdzob tsam zhes gtam/ /de chos skur 'char zhes padma dkar/ /gzhan sems 'khrid tsam yin drang po ci/ /yang gan mdzod las/ gzhi ji lta ba sangs rgyas kyi gzigs snang zhig la ngos 'dzin/ des na byang chub sems dpa'i gzigs snang thams cad de la ltos nas don dam de'i phyir mkhas pas rnam grangs pa'i don dam bden pa zhes btags/

re zhig pa'i don dam bden pa/ mthar thug gnyis 'byed pa 'dis yin no gsungs pa la/ rtsod spong du des 'byed thub par mi snang ste/ byang 'phags gzigs snang de don dam bden pa mtshan nyid pa ma yin na/ nges don yin pa 'gal/ gzigs ngo don dam bden pa yin na/ nges don ma yin pa'ang 'gal bas/ nges don du ma 'dus pa'i mthar thug ces gzhan pa la'ang rnam dpyad med zhus pa'i lan mchan bur/ nges don dang mthar thug gnyis su phye ba thugs su ma shong bar snang ste/ gsang ba 'dus par bshad pa bzhi zer ba la/ sbas don dang mthar thug ces phye ba nges don gzhir bzhag la zab khyad yin/ mkhas pa snga ma drang don dang nges don/ dang po la/ drang don gyi drang don dang / drang don gyi nges don dbyer 'byed pa bzhin/ phyi ma la yang phye bas thugs khog bskyed du gsol zhes bris snang yang / tshul bzhi'i bshad pa sbas don dang mthar thug gnyis su phye ba 'di/ skabs kyi lan du ga la 'byor te/ drang nges 'jog mtshams mang du 'dug kyang / bden gnyis dang de brjod byar ston pa zhig la dgongs pa gtad 'dug mod/ 'dir skabs sbas don mthar thug gnyis ni/ brjod bya don dam bden pa la zab khyad che bar mi snang ste/ rgyu mtshan/ spyi don zhes pa la phar phyin spyi dang skye rim spyi gnyis su phye/ sbas don gyi bshad pa ni/ dbang gong ma ma thob pa'i bum dbang tsam thob pa man chad la sbas pa/ dbang gong ma thob pa'i slob ma la rdzogs rim gyi bshad pa byed pa dang / mthar thug gi bshad pa ni/ spyi don gyi mthar thug dang / sbas don gyi mthar thug ces pa 'bras bu'i bshad pa byed pa gcig la ngos 'dzin pas/ don dam bden pa yin pa gzhir bzhag la zab khyad phye ba ci la yin/ bshad bya ci sbas mthar thug gsum la 'chad byed mtha' dag man ngag gsum dang sbyar ba'i bshad pa byed pa'i tshe/ bshad bya spyi don gnyis/ 'chad byed man ngag gsum gyi nang nas/ yan lag gi don gyi bshad pa byed pa la/

mtha' drug gi nang tshan sgra ji bzhin pa'i bshad pa zer/ bshad bya spyi don de/ 'chad byed man ngag gsum las yig don dang man ngag gnyis kyi bshad pa la/ mtha' drug gi nang tshan sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin pa'i bshad pa zer/ brjod bya sbas don 'chad byed dang pos bshad pa la nges don dang / phyi ma gnyis kyi bshad pa la drang don gyi bshad pa zer/ bshad bya mthar thug 'chad byed dang pos bshad pa la dgongs pa can ma yin pa dang / phyi ma gnyis kyi bshad pa la dgongs pa can gyi bshad pa zer bas/ bden gnyis la drang nges su bzhag pa'i 'chad tshul dang gtan mi 'dra bas/ skabs kyi rtsod lan du zur tsam yang 'gro bar ma mchis/ mkhyen yangs rgya mtsho bskyed du gsol/ spyir mkhas pa snga ma 'ga' zhig gis drang nges la bzhir phye ba yang snang mod/ byang 'phags gzigs do rnam grangs pa'i don dam bden pa dang / de sangs rgyas kyi gzigs ngo la bltos te kun rdzob bden pa yin gsungs pa 'di ga la rigs te/ shing rta'i srol 'byed dag gi gzhung lugs chen por/ sprin mthong mkha' la nyi bzhin zhes sogs dang / ji ltar tshes pa'i zla ba la/ /zhes sogs ltar/ sa dang po nas sangs rgyas sa'i bar la mthong bya rgya che chung tsam bshad kyi/ byang 'phags mnyam gzhag dang / sangs rgyas gzigs snang / chos dbyings gnas tshul gzigs tshul la log ma log gi khyad par cung zad kyang ma bshad pa'i phyir dang / gnad des na dpal ldan zla bas kyang / so so skye bo rnams kyi don dam dam pa'i bden pa gang yin pa de ni 'phags pa snang ba dang bcas pa'i spyod yul can rnams kyi kun rdzob tsam yin la/ de'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid gang yin pa de ni de rnams kyi don dam pa'o/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi don dam pa ni rang bzhin nyid yin zhing de yang bslu ba med pa nyid kyis don dam pa'i bden pa yin la/ de ni de rnams kyi so so rang gi rig par bya ba yin no zhes kun rdzob la gnyis su phye nas don dam bden pa la gnyis su phye ba sogs mi snang ba'i phyir ro/

/khong rgyal sras 'phags pa'i gzigs snang la/ /mchog rgyal rnams khro zhal bsgyur ro zhes/ /phrin bden min tsheṃms sgrib g.yo mi 'tshal/ /sras 'phags tshogs gzhon nu thugs kyang pham/ /tshul spyi sbas mthar thug bshad bya gsum/ /thabs 'chad byed drug gis 'chad pa'i tshe/ /sbas mthar thug gnyis la'ang drang nges tshang / /de nges don kho nar 'chad pa'i gtam/ /blo khong yangs bskyed kyang shong mi rigs/ /mchog sprul sku zhal 'dzum dkar na yang / /lha rdo rje snying pos bdag la khrel/ /don 'di la dgongs dbyings mtho sgron zhu/ /yang rtsod spong du/ sa dang po'i gzigs snang de don dam bden pa mtshan nyid pa ma yin na/ sangs ma rgyas bar du bden pa mthong bar yang mi 'gyur la/ don dam bden pa yin gsungs na/ de de ma yin par thal/ de rnam grangs pa'i don dam bden pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum yin zhes zhus pa la/ lan mchan bur/ phyin ci ma log pa'i yongs grub chos can du bzung nas thal phyir byas na 'khor gsum yin/ snga ma khyab pa bsgrub byar 'dug pas 'khor gsum ha ha zhes bris snang ste/ grub mtha'i skabs gang du yang ma 'brel ba'i thal phyir te/ thugs ngal/ rnam rig pa'i skabs ni rtags ma grub kyi lan thebs/ dpal 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi skabs 'dir 'dod thog tu babs pas/ 'khor gsum de 'dra phaṭ/ snga ma khyab pa bsgrub bya gsungs pa ni/ rnam grangs kyi don dam gyis don dam bden pa'i go mi chod pa mkhas pa spyi lugs/ rtags gsal dngos 'gal khyab pa yongs grags de tsam la 'khor gsum rtog ge mkhas pa'i dkyil 'khor du grags/ rtags gsal la lan thebs pa'i 'khor gsum bden na/ rtog ge pa gzhon nu a re 'tsheng / thugs gzhad sgra ha ha'i dmod tshig mda'/ /gzhan nyes med 'jim dum mgo bo bkas/ /dmod tshig mda' bsnun pa'i ched kyi yul/ /mkhar nyi ma shar tshe gar rtse skad/ /chos rtog ge mkhan gyi dkyil 'khor du/

/'brel khyab pa yongs su grags de la/ /rtags gsal bar lan gyi gdod pham na/ /don de la 'khor gsum su yang zer/ /rtag gsal bar lan gyis lce skyong na/ /tshig khyab pa khas tsam 'khor gsum zhes/ /don ma brtags ku co ma 'don cig /khong mkhas rnams khrel na rang pham mo/ /yang rtsod spong du/ sa dang po man chad du dbu ma'i lta ba mi skye ba ni ha cang thal te/ sa dang por dbu ma'i lta ba'i chos nyid mngon sum du mthong ba la/ chos mchog skabs su chos nyid la gsal snang thob pa'i dbu ma'i lta ba skye dgos pa'i phyir/ zhes zhus pa'i lan mchan bur/ mos pas dpyod pa zhes pa'i sgra tsam la yang ma brtags pa'o zhes gsung ba ni/ don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa dang gsal snang thob pa'i tshul gyi rtogs pa dang / mngon sum du rtogs pa zhes sogs thugs su ma byon pa ste/ de tsam gyi bu ma'i lta bas dbu ma'i lta ba'i go mi chod na/ mtshon byed dpe'i phyag chen gyis kyang phyag chen kyi go mi chod par 'gyur ba dang / khyad par mthar 'dzin 'gog byed dbu ma chen po'i rigs pa la brten nas dbu ma'i lta ba skyes pa zhig mi sred par 'gyur de/ rig shes rjes dpag tu gyur pa'i dbu ma'i lta ba la bkag skyon phog song bas so/ /chos mos spyod skabs su dbu ma'i lam/ /mchog lta ba med ces sprin gyi rngas/ /khong thal rang rigs pa'i 'khri shing la/ /ngo mtshar ba'i me tog 'khrungs 'di mtshar/ /sngon lha chen dregs pa'i 'phyong stabs la/ /khong drang srong ma rungs tshig mda' phog /rang che ba'i mtshon byed liṅga yang / /ngo tsha nas sa la lhung zhes grag /yang gan mdzod las/ nges tshig skabs su/ kho bo'i bla ma 'brug pa rin po rin ches ni/ phyag rgya zhes pa'i sgra ni mdor yang bshad la/ de bshad pas chen por yang bshad pa yin mod/ 'on kyang chen po dang ma sbyar bas/ mdo'i de mi gsal ba mdor bstan du song / sngags su gnyis sbyar bas/

shin tu gsal ba'i phyir sangs rgyas bshad do zhes gsungs pa la/ rtsod spong du/ 'o na 'dul lung nas/ btsun pa kun dga' bo ni slob dpon chen po'i dbang bskur bas dbang bskur mod kyi zhes pa de yang / slob dpon gyi dbang bskur mtshan nyid par thal ba dang / 'dul ba sum brgya par/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub dpal nod dbang bskur yin/ /zhes pa de yang der thal ba dang / mdo las bshad pa'i 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur de yang der thal ba dang / mthar dbang phyug chen po'i dbang bskur de yang der thal te/ mdo las bshad pa'i phyag rgya'i ming can de dag phyag chen mtshan nyid pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes bkod pa la/ lan mchan bur/ 'dul ba'i dbang la sgra bshad mtshungs/ /zhes dang / 'od zer chen po'i dbang la don mtshungs zhes dang / yang mdo las bshad pa'i phyag rgya'i ming can de dag phyag chen mtshan nyid pa yin pa'i phyir zhes pa la/ phyag rgya la phyag chen gyis khyab pa khas ma blangs pas/ gsung ba'i lan mchan bu re snang yang / sgra mtshungs kyang don mi mtshungs pa/ pha dang ma ni gsad bya zhing / /zhes sogs lta bu/ don mtshungs kyang tha snyad mi mtshungs pa/ mi dang glang chen la lag ldan gyi don mtshungs kyang / mi la lag ldan gyi tha snyad ma grags pa lta bu dang / mtsho nang gi rus sbal pa mtsho skyes kyi sgra bshad du yod kyang / de'i sgra 'jug tu med pa sogs mang du yod kyang / de dag rnam par ma phyed pa'i skyon chen po snang ste/ 'dul lung dbang dang / 'od zer chen po'i dbang / dbang mtshan nyid par bzhed na/ ming la don du 'khrul/ 'dul ba dang mdo dang gang la sngags dbang mtshan nyid pa yod par song ngo / /sgra mtshungs kyang don mi 'dra bas/ de dag mtshan nyid par mi bzhed na/ mdo las bshad pa'i phyag rgya'i ming can de dag kyang / ming mtshungs kyang phyag chen mtshan nyid pa min gsung dgos pa las/ chen po dang ma sbyar bas/ mdor bstan yin yang phyag chen mtshan nyid pa min zhes zhal bzhes gnang ba dang 'gal 'du'i phung por snang ngo /

/'gal 'du de ni/ mchan bu pho nya des bcos song ste/ mdo las bshad pa'i phyag rgya'i ming can de dag kyang / phyag chen mtshan nyid pa yin pa'i phyir byas pa la/ phyag rgya la phyag chen gyis khyab pa khas ma blangs pas rtags ma grub ces mchan bu pho nyas smras song ba'i phyir ro/ /pho nya de bden no gsung na ni/ mdo'i phyag rgya phyag chen du bzhed pa'i grub mtha' zhig nad tshad pa ri klung 'thab pa la/ /'gran bdo bzhin mdo rgyud ri klung 'thab/ /khong gzhon nu gsos kyis phan pa med/ /lha sman bla sangs rgyas spyan drongs shig /grogs 'chi med mngal sbas mtho ris bdag /mngal col chung kha nas skyugs pa'i mod/ /lha dka' thub mkhan gyi tshig mtshon mdas/ /lta mi bzod mtshan ma stong gis gtams/ /chos bla med sbas don snod min la/ /dus yang yang gsang ba gtol ba'i mtshang / /tshig ma sbas 'thol zhing chags de la/ /don kun gsal spyan stong mdzes de bsngags/ /mchog padma dkar po sprul pa'i sku/ /snyan grags dkar gdugs mdzes stong phub kyang / /gsung ldem dgongs tsha zer skyugs pa des/ /snying gdung ba bsil ba'i gdeng ma thob/ /las bsod nams bsags pa 'phags pa'i yul/ /mkhas paṇa grub gtsug rgyan nā ro pa/ /sa dkar dngas 'jam po'i rdo rje dang / /don dbyer med snying gi dkyil na bzhugs/ /zhes bod kha ba can pa'i bstan bcos kun gyi gtsug rgyan sdom gsum rab dbye zhes grags pa'i bstan bcos chen por/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir byon pa'i mang po dag gis/ chos ltar bcos pa'i bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan ci mchis pa la dag ma dag gi rab tu dbye ba so sor phye/ bka' chag gi gong ma 'khrul med de dag spyi bo'i gtsug tu bsten yang / phyis lta spyod zor yang du shor ba de dag rab dbyes rnam par phye ba la/ deng gi dus 'dir 'gran zla kun bral padma dkar pos phyag chen gan mdzod ces par lan gyi rnam gzhag ched du bsngags pa'i tshe/

kho bos kyang / phyogs snga phyi'i dgongs pa dpyis phyin par blangs nas/ gzur gnas nyams ldan gyi tshig gi srad bu la/ brjod bya don gyi mu tig phreng ba tar du brgyus pa'i lan/ phyag chen rtsod spong du grags pa'i nyung ngu zhig phul ba la/ slar yang sprul ba mchog padma dkar pos/ mchan bur btab pa'i lan phran bu gnang 'dug pa la/ yang lan mkhas pa'i mig thur zhes pa 'di ni/ stag lo zla ba bzhi pa'i dkar phyogs rang cag gi ston pa'i dus bzang po gsum ldan/ yon tan gyi cha shas yongs su gang zhing rdzogs pa gsum pa'i tshes la/ kha ba can gyi 'dren pa zla med dpal sa skya par grags pa'i mtshan can/ mkha' 'gro 'bum sde'i shel gyi skas la mkha' spyod du spyan 'dren par brtsam pa na/ gdul bya skal ldan 'dren pa'i bya ba lhag ma yod pas mi 'gro zhes/ mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gdan la zhabs brtan par bzhugs pa'i gnas/ drin can bla ma mtshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos dpal rta mgrin yang gsang gi zhal mngon sum du gzigs pa'i khang rtsegs/ mang mkhar cha lung rdo rje'i brag rdzong du/ bla ma lha dang bcas pas rgyud byin brlabs shing / rgyal ba'i bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas pa la shes nas dad pa thob ste/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la rnam dpyod kyi pad tshal bzhad pa'i bdud rtsis skal bzang gi bung ba tshim par byed pa/ yul byang phyogs kyi klog pa ba/ shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa klu sgrub ces bya bas 'gyogs par sbyar ba 'dis kyang / rang gzhan mkhas pa shes 'dod can rnams kyi rnam dpyod kyi spyan dbye bar gyur cig mkhas gang blo mig utpal snying po can/ /rnam gsal nyi gzhon mig thur 'dis reg tshe/ /spyan dbye legs par bstar ba'i cho ga yis/ /phrin las bdud rtsi smin pa'i bkra shis shog /yang lan mig thur gyen mig sha ra bhas/ /phas rgol gdong lnga bsgral ba'i las sgrib sdig /sbyang phyir rab mdzes spar gyi zla shel las/

/legs bshad bdud rtsi'i dga' char 'di babs so/ /e ma byed po rgyags pa'i sras/ /sgeg ldan gaṅgas ma dag pa'i/ /sdig ltung dri ma 'ga' med kyi/ /bde bar gnyid kyi bsam gtan 'phel/ /dag byed spar gyi dge ba'i las/ /yi ge'i rig byed rdzong ri ba/ /byams pa'i rgyal mtshan mdzes byed dang / /rkos byed mkhas pa mang mkhar ba/ /blo gros kun bzang grogs dang bcas/ /dge 'dis 'gro rnams rnam dpyod kyi/ /mig phye thar lam bsgrod par shog /dge'o/ maṅgalaṃ/ /shubhaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ yang lan mkhas pa'i mig thur spyan dbye'i cho ga PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
